argument: The refusal must be carried by the changed downstream routes and their recombination, not by a colored witness line or a caption calling two strokes a split.
A caption-free viewer should find one body that visibly divides around its interior aperture and returns at a new shoulder; if the fork reads as a decorative echo, the mutation fails.
Pointer and Enter/Space must register the same bounded refusal, while lifting it must restore the exact prior contour, axis, aperture, and route signature.
A split is an easy metaphor. Delete v004 if hiding the readout and route guides leaves only an eye-shaped void, or if the branches do not materially alter the body.
